svg.title: Windborne Crimson
svg.desc: An ink-wash painting of a woman in a flowing crimson robe, drawn through twenty-eight observational stages.

g.data-name: 02 Place the figure and hair axes
03 Revise tilt, shoulder line and motion
06 Revise the open space around the figure
11 Revise the neck, head and collar join
19 Revise wrist, fingers and cheek contour
26 Break the paint with textile and dry brush
